question: What is conversion of oil to vanaspati termed as?
solution:
The correct answer is __**hydrogenation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**Hydrogenation of Oil:**

 
• As vegetable oils have long chains and double bonds, they can go through addition processes. These substances are unsaturated. Vegetable ghee, also referred to as vanaspati ghee, is created by heating vegetable oils in the presence of Nickel catalyst, which changes the unsaturated fat into saturated fat.
 
• This process is called the hydrogenation of oil
